Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a failed evaluation where the requirement or condition is not met.
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been trained on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inspection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thorough examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence. An inspection needs to have a defined set of acceptance criteria (e.g. a checklist), a documentation of roles involved in the inspection (e.g. to document the inspector's independence) and a clear documentation of when and how it was performed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mailingList
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the mailing list used by the maintainer for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPolicy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to instructions for reporting newly discovered security vulnerabilities for a package.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/intendedUse](../../Core/Properties/intendedUse.md) instead.
The intended use of a given dataset.
Specifies the time an artifact was released.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analysis
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Analytical evaluating of data, designs, or processes methodically to verify correctness against standards or expectations. Typical analysis methods are FMEA, FTA, STPA, static analysis for MISRA compliance etc.
Hyperparameter used to build the AI model contained in the AI package.
Products out of specification require a resolution action. This is the action of resolution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exploitCreatedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability has had an exploit created against it by each `to` Agent.
The number that identifies a PO box. A PO box is a box in a post office or other postal service location assigned to an organization where postal items may be kept.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dynamicAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a dynamic analysis report for a package.
Designates elements as products where the impact of a vulnerability is being investigated.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Serial Number (ISSN)](https://www.issn.org/understanding-the-issn/what-is-an-issn/) is an eight-digit identifier for serial publications and other continuing resources standardized by [ISO 3297](https://www.iso.org/standard/84536.html). It consists of two groups of four digits separated by a hyphen, where the final character is a check digit that may be an "X". The hyphen is retained when the identifier is stored electronically to maintain the standard 9-character string format (e.g., `1464-3693`). The ISSN is media-specific; the same journal title may be assigned different identifiers for its physical and digital versions.
A value used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated as part of the process of building the software to create a releasable artifact (e.g., executable or package) from data such as source files, dependencies, built components, build process ephemeral data, and other SBOMs.
Specifies the SPDX License List version in which this license or exception identifier was deprecated.
Energy consumption incurred by an AI model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a plan, guideline or strategy how to create, perform or analyze an application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidenceUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a reporting management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify an evidence relationship item.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SupplyChain/CreateAction is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.
https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to store extra information about an Element which is not part of a review (e.g. extra information provided during the creation of the Element).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: foundBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was originally discovered by the `to` Agent(s).
Specifies an Element where a vulnerability was found.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Software/SoftwareArtifact is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point from an Artifact to an Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDistributionArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is distributed as an artifact in each `to` Element (e.g. an RPM or archive file).
Specifies whether a license or additional text identifier has been marked as deprecated.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).
Provides a map of a property name to a value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: act
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level and leadership-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, as well as publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. Typically, internal groups would meet to determine the overall response and then execute agreed upon actions. CISA recommends remediating Act vulnerabilities as soon as possible.
Identifies the full text of a License, in SPDX templating format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.
Identifies who or what supplied the artifact or VulnAssessmentRelationship referenced by the Element.
An entity that is authorized to issue identification credentials.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: video
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is video based, such as a collection of movie clips.
Specifies the SPDX License List version in which this ListedLicense or ListedLicenseException identifier was first added.
Specifies the type of responsibility held over an asset, property, or entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audio
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is audio based, such as a collection of music from the 80s.
Specifies the licenseId that is preferred to be used in place of a deprecated License or LicenseAddition.
Describes the type of annotation.
A location where a package or an item will be dropped off or delivered.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: decommission
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications for a product's retirement and/or decommissioning.
Specifies whether the License is listed as free by the Free Software Foundation (FSF).

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SupplyChain/CreateProcess is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Defines the end of a range.
An entity providing an assessment.
Threshold that was used for computation of a metric described in the metric field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other specialized or custom verification method that fits the context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: log
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Time-stamped records capturing system or operational data recorded as usually as a response to specific triggers in a specified environment.
A QUDT unit applied to measurement criteria based on product type, region, and use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: track
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability does not require action at this time. The organization would continue to track the vulnerability and reassess it if new information becomes available. CISA recommends remediating Track vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.
This is the state of an affected Element.
A container for a grouping of SPDX 3 content characterizing details (provenance, composition, licensing, etc.) about a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has other specific context information necessary to capture that the above set of enumerations does not handle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md5
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD5 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1321](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1321/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).
A name used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.
The class that helps note down the quantity of energy consumption and the unit used for measurement.
Provides the location for more information regarding an external identifier.
Indicates whether a relationship is known to be complete, incomplete, or if no assertion is made with respect to relationship completeness.
AssemblyAction represents the event of creating a product by assembling individual components.
Specifies the CVSS base, temporal, threat, or environmental severity type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assumes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element assumes each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption.
Provide an enumerated set of requirement statuses that can provide state to a requirement.
An actual change to a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crystalsKyber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Kyber](https://pq-crystals.org/kyber/)
City is a specific name used to define a locality.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doi
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Digital Object Identifier (DOI)](https://www.doi.org/the-identifier/what-is-a-doi/) is a unique, [ISO 26324](https://www.iso.org/standard/88862.html)-standardized identifier for physical, digital, or abstract objects, formatted as a prefix and suffix separated by a forward slash (e.g., `10.1000/182`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: numeric
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists only of numeric entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An examination typically focusing on compliance with policies, standards, or regulations. Usually this is done during an audit meeting, while the assessment also involves deep and detailed reviews of work products (e.g. requirements, verification specifications, reports etc.)
The ProcessReadinessType is defined by the enumeration.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obsoleted
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Superseded or not valid at present.
Capture the scope of information about a specific relationship between elements.
A buildId is a locally unique identifier used by a builder to identify a unique instance of a build produced by it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability has been fixed by the `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe22
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration Specification 2.2](https://cpe.mitre.org/files/cpe-specification_2.2.pdf).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: affects
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability, Action or DefinedProcess affects each `to` Element.
The category describes the hardware item in a DefinedType.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gtin
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Trade Item Number (GTIN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin) is a number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a trade item (product or service).
Categories of presence or absence.
Refers to one or more Elements that are part of an ElementCollection.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A generic contact point to be used when the contact type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: device
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a chipset, processor, or electronic board.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.
The version of the SPDX License List used in the license expression.
Type of the model used in the AI software.
roleQualification specifies the requirements, criteria, or conditions that must be met for an entity to be considered qualified to fulfill a particular role.
Provides a reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOutput
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build, DefinedProcess or Action element generates each `to` Element as an output.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement has been approved by stakeholder, and can be include in traceability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Identifier (IBID)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a verifiable unique identifier for legal entities as defined in the [ISO/DIS 25500-3](https://www.iso.org/standard/87705.html) draft standard. It is composed of three data elements: the International Business Registration Number (IBRN), the legal name, and the date of origin formatted as eight numeric characters (YYYYMMDD). Each element is separated by a pipe character (`|`) (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657|Code Management Association|19990420`).

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Software/artifactSize](../../Software/Properties/artifactSize.md) instead.
Size of the dataset.
Information related to hardware dimension.
Evaluation is an outcome considering results of a verification.
Type of support that is associated with an artifact.
A License participating in an 'or later' model.
Property that describes the URI of the build configuration source file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executable
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an Artifact that can be run on a computer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is the evidence that a specification or requirement has been fulfilled.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/ExpandedLicensing/License is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Provides the location of an exploit catalog.
Safety risk level.
Defines the line range in the original host file that the snippet information applies to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory is defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.
Defines the original host file that the snippet information applies to.
A prescribed alteration of a product.
Defines the byte range in the original host file that the snippet information applies to.
Provides a License author's preferred text to indicate that a file is covered by the License.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: binaryArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to binary artifacts related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: low
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Low/no risk is posed by an AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gln
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Location Number (GLN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gln) is a 13-digit number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a legal entity (e.g., a company or customer), a function within a legal entity, a physical location (e.g., a warehouse or a specific shelf in a store), or a digital location (e.g., an Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) gateway).
An Individual Value for License when no assertion can be made about its actual value.
Impact justification label to be used when linking a vulnerability to an element representing a VEX product with a VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship relationship.
ManufactureAction represents the act of creating a product by a manufacturing process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: highAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 4 - High automation. The system performs parts of its mission without external intervention.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other relevant type of proof or documentation not covered above.
Confidentiality level of the data points contained in the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. It is used to represent either a temporal order (e.g., in a workflow) or a logical order for processing and traversal (e.g., in an ordered list).
A license expression participating in a license set.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildMeta
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the build metadata related to a published package.
Gives information about the circumstances or unifying properties that Elements of the bundle have been assembled under.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eori
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/customs/customs-procedures-import-and-export/customs-operations/economic-operators-registration-and-identification-number-eori_en) is a unique identifier for businesses undertaking customs operations across European Union customs territory, such as import, export, and transit. It consists of an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code followed by a national identifier of up to 15 alphanumeric characters (e.g., `PL1234567890ABCDE`).
A known location is specified at this time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packageUrl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Package-URL (PURL), as defined in [ECMA-427](https://ecma-international.org/publications-and-standards/standards/ecma-427/).
A evidenceUID is a unique identifier assigned to an entity, item, or requirement.
HarvestAction represents the act of creating a product by directly extracting goods or materials from nature.
The CreateProcess refers to the abstract process class that can be used to represent the process of creation of a product.
Results of general safety risk assessment of the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasEvidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is considered as evidence for the `from` Element (`from` hasEvidence `to`).
Sets the context for an assessment by specifying the related project.
Domain in which the AI package can be used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is no support for the artifact from the supplier, consumer assumes any support obligations.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTestCase
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test case for the `from` Element (`from` hasTestCase `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: email
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Email address, as defined in [RFC 3696](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3696/) Section 3.
Information related to physical hardware.
Identifies the size of a software Artifact, in bytes.
Provides advise on how to mitigate or remediate a vulnerability when a VEX product is affected by it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specification is a detailed document (or set of documents) that describes the requirements, design, behavior, or other characteristics of a system, component, or process so that all stakeholders have a clear, unambiguous reference.
A standard with which the artifact complies.
Provides information about the content type of an Element or a property.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 4.0 - 6.9.
Link to the project contract.
Provides a detailed description of the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: none
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is 0.0.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: generates
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element generates each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Software profile specification.
A textual expression describing the actual need defined by the requirement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasHost
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build was run on the `to` Element during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the host that the build runs on).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element (the instructions) runs on each `to` /Hardware/Hardware (processing element), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
A transport route refers to the specific path or network used to move people, goods, data, or resources from one location to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: critical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 9.0 - 10.0.
Specifies the type of an external identifier.
Information about the AI software, not including the model description.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doesNotAffect
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability has no impact on each `to` Element. The use of the `doesNotAffect` is constrained to `/Security/VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A systematic examination of a system, process, or outcome to evaluate compliance of specific work products with a specific expectation with a specification, regulation or standard. Often involves judgement and a rationale of this judgement.
Identifies the nature of the contactPointRelationship.
Specifies the SSVC decision type.
Confidentiality level.
Provides the result of an export control assessment.
This is the individual, business, or organization who currently manages goods, services, or assets.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRoleIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a role in the `to` Element. The use of the hasRoleIn is constrained to `RoleRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).
The type of external reference.
EvidenceType refers to categories of documented or observable proof used to verify compliance, qualification, or performance
A set of geographic point location coordinates.
Provide an enumerated set of lifecycle phases that can provide context to relationships.
